plan.procedure: This runbook has exactly three actions. Assemble the public archive and verify the release notes; these two preparatory actions have no prerequisites and may finish in either order. Distribution of the archive is forbidden until BOTH archive assembly AND release-note verification are complete. No additional prerequisites apply.

steps.action: Generate the public release bundle from approved source files.
Check the release notes for accuracy and completeness.
Distribute the finished archive to the public download location.
